subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should trusted HTTP callers be allowed to trigger OpenClaw package updates through the Gateway, and if so should that be a new `/admin/update` route or an explicit `update.run` addition to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the choice changes a privileged operator boundary that can replace packages and restart the Gateway, so automation should not choose the permanent HTTP exposure model.

options.title: Design via admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Keep this open and require a maintainer-approved, default-off `update.run` HTTP RPC design with docs, private-ingress guidance, recovery semantics, and tests.

options.title: Split version and update work
options.body: Move the version field discussion to the existing version tracker and open or keep a narrower HTTP update authority issue for the remaining security decision.

options.title: Decline HTTP update triggering
options.body: Close the update endpoint direction as not planned and keep update authority on CLI, Control UI, and WebSocket RPC only.

recommendation.title: Design via admin HTTP RPC
recommendation.body: Keep this open and require a maintainer-approved, default-off `update.run` HTTP RPC design with docs, private-ingress guidance, recovery semantics, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product/security boundary direction rather than a narrow code repair, and steipete is the clearest product-context reviewer in the related updater workflow discussion.
